chapters.title: The First Night
chapters.summary: A sleepy shop, a watchful cat, and the little ghost who comes back for strawberry milk.

chapters.title: Things That Don't Belong
chapters.summary: The forest loses its birdsong, an old friendship waits in a library book, and Wren searches for a passenger.

chapters.title: The Forgotten Town
chapters.summary: Photographs change, Bellwether forgets its own streets, and the Conductor remembers the missing.

chapters.title: The Midnight Train
chapters.summary: The hidden platform opens, and Miso's long watch begins to make sense.

chapters.title: The Last Light
chapters.summary: Elias, Agnes, and the old lighthouse reveal what Moonmart was built to protect.

chapters.title: Until Morning Comes
chapters.summary: Bellwether chooses how to remember its visitors, and the player decides what the doorway will become.

memory.text: Agnes welcomed you with a warm pastry.
You remembered Pip's strawberry milk and did not ask them to explain the impossible.
Agnes trusted you with a receipt she had kept for decades.
You studied the old photograph together, without forcing an answer.
You helped Pip remember the feeling of being safe.
Fern trusted you enough to describe the silence in Whisperwood.
Lucien let you borrow the detective novel he has reread for years.
Wren shared the map she has carried from town to town.
You promised to help Fern listen for the birds again.

creates_promises.text: Help Fern hear the birds sing through the grove again.

memory.text: You stood with Fern when the first birds returned to the grove.

resolves_promises.memory: Fern hears the birdsong return, and remembers that you stayed to listen with her.

memory.text: You noticed the name Ada inside Lucien's old book.
You helped Lucien write a letter that asks for nothing in return.
Wren told you her sister boarded a train that never reached its stop.
You promised Wren you would keep looking for her sister.

creates_promises.text: Keep searching with Wren until her sister's name can be found in the passenger records.

memory.text: You and Agnes saw the same face disappear from the shop photograph.
Mara trusted you with a letter that arrived without an address.
You gave the lost passenger time to find his name.
The Conductor recognized that you had listened to a forgotten passenger.
Agnes told you what she remembers of the Long Midnight.
You compared the old town map with the post office records.
You wrote Osric's name back into the town ledger.
The Conductor promised to show you the platform when it was safe.

creates_promises.text: Wait until the Midnight Platform is safe, then visit it with the Conductor.

memory.text: Wren found her family mark on a ticket that should not exist.
You stepped onto the Midnight Platform together.

resolves_promises.memory: The Conductor kept their word and walked beside you onto the safe platform.

memory.text: You read the passenger names aloud so they would not vanish again.

resolves_promises.memory: You and Wren found her family's mark in the passenger records, preserving a lead while leaving her sister's next step to her.

memory.text: Agnes finally explained why Miso has never left the shop.
You promised that Miso would not have to guard the doorway alone.

creates_promises.text: Make sure Miso can choose whether to stay by the doorway or rest.

memory.text: Elias described the light he keeps seeing across the water.
Elias let you read the lighthouse log he hid after the Long Midnight.
Wren helped you restore the lighthouse lens without spending a single memory.
Agnes admitted that her family once kept the doorway's agreement.
You and Elias lit the beacon for every lost traveller, not just the train.
You read the original agreement and found that it asked for shelter, not sacrifice.
Pip helped welcome the travellers who came to Moonmart before dawn.
You asked Miso what the cat wanted instead of deciding on Miso's behalf.
The boundary steadied when everyone who remembered it chose what came next.

resolves_promises.memory: Miso's choice is honored, and no one is left to guard the doorway alone.

memory.text: You made a new covenant that honors the path Bellwether chose.

endings.title: The Keeper
endings.epilogue: Moonmart keeps its light burning for anyone who needs a safe place between journeys.

endings.title: The Open Door
endings.epilogue: Bellwether's human and supernatural neighbours begin to share the town openly.

endings.title: The Gentle Goodbye
endings.epilogue: The doorway closes gently. Moonmart remains an ordinary shop, and nobody's kindness is forgotten.
